name: Tobu Railway Co., Ltd.
summary: Tobu Railway Co., Ltd. provides private rail system services in Japan. The company operates health clubs, golf courses, theme parks, and hotels. It also develops and manages condominiums, housing developments, department stores, and other properties along its railways. In addition, the company operates sightseeing service center, station information, railroadmap, Wi-Fi, information on unstaffed stations, alternative transportation, and buying pasmo cards and tickets, as well as sightseeing destinations, access information, and special tickets.
